svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-2-transports" name="process-view-level-2-transports"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant FE as Frontend
 participant IN as Infrastructure
 participant BE as Backend
 participant T as Porto Digital [FIWARE]
 loop Scheduled import, every N seconds [PENDING]
 BE->>T: Fetch transport data [HTTPS, timeout]
 alt Valid data
 T-->>BE: Bus positions
 BE->>IN: Save as last valid data, with its time (database)
 else Timeout, error or invalid data
 BE->>IN: Keep last valid data, record failed import (database)
 end
 end
 P->>FE: Opens the transport screen
 loop Every few seconds while the screen is open
 FE->>IN: Get next transport options [HTTPS/JSON] (API gateway)
 IN->>BE: Forward
 BE->>IN: Read regular lines and event shuttles (database)
 BE-->>FE: Options, time of the data, source status
 alt Source available
 FE-->>P: Next options home, \"Data from HH:MM\"
 else Source unavailable
 FE-->>P: Last valid data, \"Data from HH:MM\", warning, event shuttles still shown
 end
 end
 Note over BE,T: The backend never calls the transport source inside a user's request
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
